lastCompletedStory.title: Unranked issues compete by WSJF in plannable selection

nextStoryContext: selectPlannableIssue (src/issues/select.ts) now does champion-vs-champion selection: pickRankedChampion (min rank, numeric-id tiebreak) vs pickUnrankedChampion (max computeWsjf, numeric-id tiebreak); the unranked champion only wins on strictly-higher WSJF than the ranked champion's WSJF (ties go to ranked). This also changes selectPlannableFromFile and feeds selectPlanTargetFromFile's no-target path (both call selectPlannableIssue internally) and the meta-loop auto-dispatcher (buildProductionDispatchFn in src/commands/sidecar.ts) transparently -- no call-site changes were needed for US-001. selectPlannableById / selectPlanTargetFromFile (the CAM-154 explicit-target path) are untouched: they still do exact-id lookup with never-fall-back semantics and do not need WSJF competition logic. US-002 (plan-runner terminal for invalid explicit target) builds directly on selectPlanTargetFromFile returning null for a non-plannable/absent explicit target -- that null-on-invalid-target behavior was already correct pre-US-001 and is unaffected by this story's changes.
